chunks: And it was said to al-Sadiq, peace be upon him:
A man had blood on his garment, of a kind in which salat is not permissible, and he performed tawaf in his garment.
So he said: “The tawaf sufficed for him in it; then he should remove it and perform salat in a pure garment.”

key_terms.أَجْزَأَهُ: it was sufficient and valid for him
key_terms.اَلصَّلَاةُ: salat, whose validity requires purity of clothing in this context
key_terms.فَطَافَ: he performed tawaf around the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: Is tawaf valid if there is blood on one's garment that would invalidate salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tawaf and ritual purity of clothing. It indicates that tawaf performed in a garment bearing blood of a type that would invalidate salat remains valid, while the subsequent salat must be performed in a pure garment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: It was said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as): "A man had blood on his garment, of a type that invalidates prayer, and he performed Tawaf in that garment."
Imam (as) said: "His Tawaf is valid, but he should then remove the garment and pray in a pure garment."
